nirvana.definition: STATE_OF_NIRVANA: every required gate PASS on the same exact source SHA in at least sustain_pulses consecutive observed pulses. UNKNOWN, FAIL or a missing gate is never PASS.
nirvana.note: NIRVANA frees a window slot; it is engineering completion, not an owner point release (H12 still needs a separate owner decision).

admission.empty_queue: slot stays EMPTY; never back-filled with a graduated repo

golden_thread_note: A step with no mapped evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS. '@candidate_branch' passes only when the row declares a candidate branch and a 40-hex candidate SHA.

streaks.unit: observed pulse (a hash-pinned focus snapshot), not calendar time

definitions.streak_on_current: consecutive PASS pulses ending at the latest pulse (0 if the latest is not PASS)
definitions.streak_record: longest consecutive PASS run in observed history
definitions.previous_streak: length of the most recent completed PASS run before the current state (null if none)
definitions.nevergreen: true when the gate has never been PASS in any observed pulse
definitions.regressions: count of PASS to non-PASS transitions
definitions.unattended: UNKNOWN for at least unattended_after_pulses consecutive latest pulses; null while history is shorter

source_red.definition: A FAIL gate ranked by what it unlocks: gates in the same repo that transitively require it and are not PASS, plus outbound repo edges that are AUTHORITY_BOUND or carry receipts/telemetry. A gate failing in at least common_cause_min_repos window repos is a COMMON_CAUSE source red.
